note: City of Johnston City campground at the Arrowhead Recreation & Wildlife Area, on a 30-acre lake 1.5 miles off I-57 Exit 59. Most RV sites sit on open lawn west of the camp road; the few east of it look over the lake through a band of trees. Trolling motors only; a 2.25-mile trail circles the lake. RV sites book online; tent sites and the cabin through the office. RV Life lists it as commercial; it is municipal. --Claude
